chapter: Tulane, Tuxedo and Waifs' Home bands
title: Creole Serenaders and Peter Bocage
summary: Tillman never belonged to Peter Bocage's Creole Serenaders, only playing jobs with him in recent years.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Man, there's so much I want to ask you about. There's so many different people. Just keep on asking. Yeah. Let the money grow up.
Yeah. Don't let your pocket get no hole in it.

Yeah, well, we can do it again. Anyway, what about the Creole Serenaders? Creole Serenaders? Did you ever play with them? Peter Boccage had them. Oh no, I never. You never played with them. I just wanted a few.
The only playing I did with Pete was, you know, since these recent years. Yeah, I played on the job, but I never was a member of his band. I see.
